full_text:
Article 4 (Preparation and Finalization of Draft Reports on Important Audit Results, etc.)
(1) A draft report on important audit results, etc. shall concisely describe the key findings of the audit, focusing on the relevant facts. <Amended on Nov. 2, 2020>
(2) A draft report on important audit results, etc. shall be finalized following deliberation and resolution by the Board of Commissioners of the Board of Audit and Inspection. <Amended on Nov. 2, 2020>
